known_glosses.translation: The Etruscans call the flute player 'subulo'

known_glosses.text: aesar enim Etrusca lingua deus dicitur
known_glosses.translation: For 'aesar' in the Etruscan language means god

known_glosses.text: lanista Etrusco vocabulo appellatur gladiatorum magister
known_glosses.translation: The gladiator trainer is called lanista with an Etruscan word
hister was called ludio in Tuscan language
Among the Etruscans cheese is most praised
Which the Etruscans call the king lucumo
mantissa is said with Tuscan name to mean addition
persona is a word derived from the Etruscans
atrium is said to be of Etruscan origin
The Tyrrhenians call the household god lar

negative_examples.translation: The Romans call the consul a magistrate
negative_examples.reason: Pattern should only match Etruscan/Tuscan references

negative_examples.translation: In Greek language they call it philosophy

complex_passages.text: Tusci vocant subulo quod nos tibicinem, et Etrusca lingua ais deum significat
complex_passages.translation: The Etruscans call subulo what we call flute player, and in Etruscan language ais means god

complex_passages.text: In libris haruspicum, quos Etrusci disciplinae suae auctores habent, legitur nomen aruspex ab Etruscis derivatum esse, quod Tusci vocant haruga extis inspiciendis praepositum
complex_passages.translation: In the books of the haruspices, which the Etruscans have as authorities of their discipline, one reads that the name haruspex is derived from the Etruscans, which the Tuscans call haruga the one appointed for inspecting entrails

greek_passages.text: Τυρρηνοὶ καλοῦσι λαρ τὸν οἰκεῖον δαίμονα
greek_passages.translation: The Tyrrhenians call lar the household deity
